home.title: Flood Response
home.masthead.title: Assam Floods 2026 Emergency Coordination
home.masthead.description: Emergency response is active in your region. Transmit instant SOS alerts, report localized flood conditions, or request essential food, water, and medical relief with official disaster desks.
home.action.reportArea.title: Report flooded area
home.action.reportArea.detail: Share real-time water levels, submerged access roads, bridge breaches, and stranded citizen headcounts.
home.action.requestRelief.title: Request relief
home.action.requestRelief.detail: Request urgent food rations, clean drinking water, infant baby formula, medicines, or tarpaulin shelter kits.
home.sos.label: SOS
home.sos.title: Immediate Distress Dispatch
home.sos.description: Press and hold if you or others are stranded in life-threatening water conditions.
home.sos.support: Direct connection to State Emergency Operations (SEOC), NDRF 1st Battalion, and SDRF Water Rescue squads.

affectedArea.location.title: Where is the flooding?
affectedArea.location.description: Choose any ONE method to share location — whichever is easiest for you right now.
affectedArea.location.device.title: Device
affectedArea.location.device.description: Acquire high-precision satellite coordinates directly from your device browser. No manual typing required.
affectedArea.location.device.hint: Works offline with cached satellite • Accuracy ~5-15m
affectedArea.location.search.title: Search Village or Landmark
affectedArea.location.search.desktopTitl: Search Village, Landmark, or Revenue Circle
affectedArea.location.search.desktopDesc: Type village, gaon panchayat name, river ghat, school shelter, or embankment mile marker.
affectedArea.location.search.placeholder: e.g. Kamalabari Ghat, Salmara, Garamur, Nimati Bund...
affectedArea.location.map.title: Tap to Pin on Map
affectedArea.location.map.desktopTitle: Tap or Pin on Interactive Flood Map
affectedArea.location.map.description: Visual point selection on offline grid
affectedArea.location.map.desktopDescrip: Visually identify river embankment breaches, island sandbars (char areas), or your exact rooftop location.
affectedArea.location.saved: Your answers are kept while you complete this report
affectedArea.location.savedDesktop: Your answers are kept on this device while you complete this report
affectedArea.support.emergency.title: Life Threatening Situation?
affectedArea.support.emergency.descripti: If water level is currently rising above household floor level or family members are marooned on rooftop, do not wait for the form.
affectedArea.support.emergency.footer: Toll-free direct lines available 24/7 in all local languages
affectedArea.support.privacy.title: Privacy & Data Masking
affectedArea.support.privacy.description: Public situation maps only show general kilometer grid zones. Your exact household coordinates and phone number (98••••••12) are protected and shared exclusively with verified NDRF / SDRF field rescuers.
affectedArea.support.connectivity.title: Cellular Tower Blackouts
affectedArea.support.connectivity.descri: If transmission drops mid-way, this form retains all entered details in your browser cache. Simply continue to step 4 and press Submit; it will flush to the rescue server automatically as soon as any signal touches your phone.
